then.text: I'll be at the chapel Saturday. Have a Welsh cake for the road.
Sing? Me? I do a fair first tenor, mind. But I'm not singing for just anybody. A question first. Which hymn tune is named for this valley?
Which hymn tune is named for the Rhondda?
Cwm Rhondda! 'Bread of heaven'! Good girl, good boy, good whatever you are. I'll sing. Tell Elwyn I'll bring Welsh cakes for the second row.
You found the first tenor for the eisteddfod choir.

else.text: No, no, no. Go and ask the old boys on the bench outside. Come back when you've got it.
Welsh cakes, picau ar y maen: cakes on the stone. Flour, butter, currants, sugar and patience. Never an oven, never a rolling pin you've washed.
Mind, I sing as well as I bake. Ask Elwyn at the chapel if he's short of voices. He always is.
